ITEM 1 | Roasted orange-fleshed chunks with browned, caramelized outer edges and a slightly glossy, moist surface; cube-like pieces about 3 cm across, several clustered center-right, sitting directly on the white plate | 95
ITEM 2 | Pale cream-to-golden wedge pieces with a light tan, lightly browned skin edge and matte, dry-looking surface; wedge shapes about 3 to 4 cm long, scattered around the left and top of the plate | 85
ITEM 3 | Golden-tan wedge pieces with darker browned, slightly crisp edges and a faintly oily sheen, about 3 to 4 cm long, one piece at bottom center and others mixed among the orange chunks | 60
ITEM 4 | Thin smear and small dots of reddish-pink sauce spread lightly across the plate surface, mostly right and lower-right of the food, flat and thin with a slight sheen | 10
